coverage_claim: Official-source audit only; no warehouse coverage.

cities.government_boundary: Nairobi City County is the defensible legal-government anchor, not the full UN Degree-of-Urbanization built-up area.
cities.source_format: official document-library previews and Controller of Budget consolidated PDF reports; grid exports contain document metadata, not fiscal line items
cities.blocker: The National Treasury's official Bajeti Yetu portal identifies Nairobi City County as county id 47 and lists eight FY2021/22-FY2023/24 budget-implementation documents, but exposes them only through document preview links. The page's CSV/XLS export is a grid export of document names, years and types, not coded expenditure rows; the same Nairobi page reports zero County Budget Books and zero County Financial Statements. The Controller of Budget publishes consolidated county implementation reports as PDFs. No official CSV/XLSX/JSON/API containing coded Nairobi County budget or execution lines was verified, so no rows were loaded.
cities.probe_result: Both Cloud Builds succeeded. The targeted county-id-47 probe found eight preview?id document links, only framework grid-export assets, zero public data/API links, and Controller of Budget PDF downloads; Nairobi's own website failed TLS certificate validation in the pinned Python image.
